decision: Keep the first occurrence of each exact duplicate row
reason: Exact copies of a patient record do not represent additional patients.

issue: gender spellings that are not a code
decision: Strip surrounding whitespace, lowercase, and map to F/M/X; leave blanks and unknown values missing
reason: Spellings such as female and woman represent the same category; unknown values cannot be inferred.

decision: Uppercase site codes and remove all spaces and hyphens
reason: N-01, n01, and N 01 refer to the same site, N01.

decision: Replace 9999 with a missing value and use nullable Int64
reason: The sentinel 9999 means not recorded and is not a valid birth year.

issue: weight column named wt_kg in visits_south.csv
decision: Rename wt_kg to weight_kg before concatenating the exports
reason: Both offices report the same weight measurement in kilograms, so the values belong in one column.

issue: sbp sentinel 999 and readings outside 70 through 250
decision: Keep readings from 70 through 250 inclusive and set all other values to missing
reason: The sentinel 999 means not measured, and out-of-range values violate the assignment data contract.

issue: impossible and loosely written visit dates
decision: Accept only exact YYYY-MM-DD strings representing valid calendar dates
reason: Dates such as 2026-02-29 do not exist, and loosely formatted dates violate the required format.

decision: Remove exact duplicates, sort by visit_time, and keep the last row for each patient-visit key
reason: Readings at different times for the same patient and visit are rechecks; the assignment requires the later reading.

decision: Keep only site records whose record_status is current
reason: Retired names are historical versions of the same site and would multiply rows during a merge.
